customManagers.description: Module versions the Makefile names when it copies files into vendor/

packageRules.description: Modules the Makefile patches, directly or through sonic-mgmt-common's patches/apply.sh. A bump has to refresh the patch, so it opens on its own, and only on dashboard approval. A security update still opens, on its own (see vulnerabilityAlerts above, which repeats this list), and the vendor-pin label keeps the preset from labeling it automerge.
prBodyNotes: This module is also copied into `vendor/` at a pinned version, by the `Makefile` or by sonic-mgmt-common's `patches/apply.sh`, and may be patched there. Move that pin, and refresh any patch, with this update, or the build keeps the old code. A security update to it is therefore never labeled `automerge`.
